title: Create Upgraded Smart+ App O2O Catalog Ads
content_data:
This article walks you through the steps to create Upgraded Smart+ App Online-to-Offline (O2O) Catalog Ads.

Based on your iOS 14 Dedicated Campaign (DC) requirements, you can choose to set up either non-DC or DC App O2O Catalog Ads.

- To create a non-DC Campaign using an O2O catalog, see [Create Upgraded Smart+ non-DC App O2O Catalog Ads](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-upgraded-smart-non-dc-app-o2o-catalog-ads/v1.3).
- To create a DC Campaign using an O2O catalog, see [Create Upgraded Smart+ DC App O2O Catalog Ads](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/create-upgraded-smart-dc-app-o2o-catalog-ads/v1.3).
seo_title: Create Upgraded Smart+ TikTok App O2O Catalog Ads
seo_description: Find the guide that best fits your Upgraded Smart+ TikTok App O2O Catalog Ads scenario. App O2O Catalog Ads are App Campaigns powered by an O2O catalog.
